errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the green line is plotted against the right Y-axis. In fact, all three lines in the chart are plotted against the left Y-axis. For example, the value for the green line in 2008 is approximately 39%, which corresponds to the left axis, not the right one (which would be ~61%).

errors.evidence: As a result of incorrectly reading the green line against the right Y-axis, all the reported numerical values are wrong. The correct approximate values, read from the left Y-axis, are: starts at ~39% (not 61%), drops to ~30% (not 56%), rises to ~39-40% (not 60-61%), decreases to ~26% (not 54-55%), reaches a low of ~20% (not 49%), and ends at ~22% (not 50%).
